# Overview

What a methods section or a reproduction needs: the workflow version and the
command of the run, the version of every tool, the reference files with their
sources and checksums, and every setting applied. The values come from the
settings the workflow recorded for the run (`logs/batches/`), the tool
environments of the image and the manifest of the resources folder.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(yaml)

PROJECT_DIR <- params$project_dir
RESULTS_DIR <- params$results_dir
if (!nzchar(PROJECT_DIR) || !dir.exists(file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "logs", "batches"))) {
  stop("Set project_dir to the project folder holding logs/batches/: ", PROJECT_DIR)
}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = PROJECT_DIR)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r inputs}
# Most recent real run (not a dry run) with a complete record
settings_files <- sort(list.files("logs/batches", pattern = "^run_.*_settings\\.yaml$",
                                  full.names = TRUE))
settings_list <- lapply(settings_files, yaml::read_yaml)
usable <- vapply(settings_list,
                 function(s) !is.null(s$chip) && !isTRUE(s$run$dry_run),
                 logical(1))
if (!any(usable)) stop("No run settings with a chip block in logs/batches/")
settings      <- settings_list[[max(which(usable))]]
settings_file <- settings_files[[max(which(usable))]]

tools_file <- "reports/results/tool_versions.tsv"
if (!file.exists(tools_file)) stop("Tool versions not found: ", tools_file)
tools <- read.delim(tools_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = "character")

# Every leaf of a nested list as one row: dotted key, value
flatten <- function(x, prefix = "") {
  rows <- list()
  for (key in names(x)) {
    name <- if (nzchar(prefix)) paste0(prefix, ".", key) else key
    value <- x[[key]]
    if (is.list(value) && !is.null(names(value))) {
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- flatten(value, name)
    } else {
      text <- if (is.null(value)) "null" else paste(unlist(value), collapse = ", ")
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(setting = name, value = text)
    }
  }
  if (length(rows) == 0) return(data.frame(setting = character(0), value = character(0)))
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
```

# Run

```{r run}
n_samples <- if (file.exists(settings$samples)) {
  length(unique(read.delim(settings$samples, colClasses = "character")$sample))
} else {
  NA
}
run <- data.frame(
  item = c("workflow version", "image", "code", "git commit", "data type", "samples",
           "machine limits", "settings record", "command"),
  value = c(
    settings$workflow$version,
    settings$workflow$image,
    paste0(settings$workflow$code, " (", settings$workflow$mode, ")"),
    if (is.null(settings$workflow$git_commit)) "-" else settings$workflow$git_commit,
    toupper(settings$data_type),
    n_samples,
    paste0(settings$machine$cores, " cores, ", settings$machine$mem_gb, " GB"),
    basename(settings_file),
    settings$run$command
  )
)
run
```

# Tools

Pinned versions, from the environment files the image is built from, and the
versions installed in the image. Programs in the base environment run the
workflow steps; somalier and R run from their own environments.

```{r tools}
differing <- tools %>%
  dplyr::filter(installed != "not found", installed != pinned,
                !startsWith(installed, paste0(pinned, ".")))
if (nrow(differing) > 0) {
  message("Installed versions that differ from the pins: ",
          paste(differing$environment, differing$package, collapse = ", "))
}
tools
```

R packages loaded by the reports:

```{r r_packages}
packages <- c("maftools", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "tidyr", "rmarkdown", "knitr", "yaml")
data.frame(package = c("R", packages),
           version = c(paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = "."),
                       vapply(packages, function(p) as.character(packageVersion(p)), character(1))))
```

# Reference files

Files of the resources folder (`reference.dir`), as recorded in its
`MANIFEST.tsv` by `hemaclone.sh resources`: source, size, MD5 and date.

```{r resources}
manifest_file <- file.path(settings$reference$dir, "MANIFEST.tsv")
manifest <- data.frame()
if (file.exists(manifest_file)) {
  manifest <- read.delim(manifest_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = "character")
  manifest
} else {
  message("No MANIFEST.tsv in ", settings$reference$dir,
          ": the folder was not built by hemaclone.sh resources, so sources and checksums are not recorded.")
}
```

Files used by the run, by setting:

```{r reference_used}
used <- flatten(settings$reference_resolved, "reference")
used <- rbind(used, data.frame(setting = "pon.vcf",
                               value = if (is.null(settings$pon_resolved)) "none" else settings$pon_resolved))
used$in_manifest <- if (nrow(manifest) > 0) {
  folder <- paste0(sub("/$", "", settings$reference$dir), "/")
  vapply(used$value, function(path) {
    relative <- if (startsWith(path, folder)) substring(path, nchar(folder) + 1) else path
    relative %in% manifest$file || paste0(relative, "/VERSION") %in% manifest$file
  }, logical(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
} else {
  NA
}
used
```

# Settings

Every setting of the run, after the defaults, the `--settings` file, `--set`
values and launch flags were merged. Sample sheet rows are not listed.

```{r settings}
skip <- c("samples", "workflow", "run", "reference_resolved", "pon_resolved", "machine")
all_settings <- flatten(settings[setdiff(names(settings), skip)])
all_settings
```

# Export

```{r export}
dir.create(RESULTS_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(run,          file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "methods_run.csv"),       row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(used,         file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "methods_references.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(all_settings, file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "methods_settings.csv"),  row.names = FALSE)
```
